items.method: Cross-read the sector-rotation acceleration (defensive staples in, discretionary out), the real-assets crypto and industrial-metal scores and the bond model's high-yield-versus-investment-grade price-ratio direction to gauge whether cross-asset risk appetite is broad, then test that against equity internals — market-heatmap breadth, the defensive sector rotation and the put-leaning option premium under negative dealer gamma — to judge whether equities are ratifying or resisting the risk-on signal, and anchor invalidation to the put-wall level the corridor depends on.
items.note: The genuinely new signature this window is a risk-on cross-asset tape that equity internals are quietly resisting. Real assets are led by crypto — ETH-USD 75.8 and BTC-USD 71.7 both in uptrends — industrial copper (CPER) reads 63.5 with broad commodities firm (PDBC 62.0, DBC 61.7), and the bond model reads the high-yield-versus-investment-grade price ratio strengthening across both aligned pairs. Yet inside equities the sector model is rotating defensive, with staples (XLP) accelerating into Leading at +4.17 while discretionary (XLY) is Peaking at -1.31; market-heatmap breadth is only 58.1% of 134 constituents, still 1.9 points shy of the 60% broad-participation line; and option premium has flipped slightly put-heavy ($424.8M puts versus $341.4M calls, 0.4456 call fraction) with an $18.6M SPY 763 put and a $9.8M NVDA 210 put among the top prints. SPY near 762.96 is pinned about 5.46 points below the 768.42 dealer flip in negative gamma with VIX 15.93. So credit, crypto and commodities are confirming an appetite that equity leadership, breadth and hedging flow have not yet ratified. Watch breadth clearing the 60% line and a reclaim of the 768.42 flip as the confirming triggers; the constructive cross-asset read is invalidated on a daily close below ~760.00 on SPY, which loses the 760 put wall in negative gamma and reopens downside toward the lower strikes.
items.title: Cross-asset risk appetite (crypto leadership, firm copper, strengthening HY/IG price ratio) is running risk-on while equity internals resist — sector rotation turned defensive into staples (XLP), breadth stuck at 58.1% under the 60% line, and option premium flipped slightly put-heavy

items.method: Cross-read the real-assets model scores across crypto, industrial and broad-commodity, gold, silver and energy vehicles, then compare each vehicle's near-term (21-day and 63-day) momentum against its 6-month (126-day) momentum to locate where the real-asset bid is genuinely accelerating versus decaying, read that against the defensive equity rotation to place the cyclical-versus-defensive balance, and anchor the read's invalidation to the broad-tape benchmark the constructive cyclical leg leans on.
items.note: The new divergence this window sits inside the real-asset complex itself: the bid is concentrated in crypto and industrial/broad commodities while monetary metals and energy lag. ETH-USD 75.8 and BTC-USD 71.7 lead in uptrends, copper (CPER) reads 63.5 with 21-day momentum +4.99 and broad baskets firm (DBC 61.7, PDBC 62.0), but gold (GLD) is only 50.6 with 6-month momentum negative at -10.95 even as its 21-day pops +15.24, silver (SLV) is weak at 23.5 with 63-day -8.61 and 126-day -22.46, and oil (USO) reads just 44.0 and Mixed with 21-day -3.39 and 63-day -6.29 despite a stale +63.24 on the 126-day. So the cyclical and crypto side is carrying the real-asset bid while the monetary-metal and energy legs lag or decay — and it lands against an equity tape that is itself rotating defensive into staples (XLP) out of discretionary (XLY). Watch gold reclaiming positive 6-month momentum and USO reclaiming positive 21- and 63-day momentum as the triggers that would broaden the real-asset bid; because this constructive cyclical read is expressed at the index level, it is invalidated on a daily close below ~760.00 on SPY, which breaks the broad-tape support the cyclical rotation leans on.
items.title: The real-asset bid is concentrated in crypto and industrial/broad commodities while monetary metals and oil lag — ETH-USD 75.8 and copper (CPER) 63.5 firm, but gold (GLD) 50.6 carries negative 6-month momentum, silver (SLV) 23.5 is weak and oil (USO) 44.0 reads mixed
